episodes.name: 2018 bubble burst
episodes.note: After the Dec 2017 top (~$19.8k) BTC fell to ~$6k by 6 Feb 2018.

episodes.name: 2018 capitulation
episodes.note: The Bitcoin Cash hash war; BTC broke $6k support and fell to ~$3.2k.

episodes.name: 2019 spring rally
episodes.note: BTC rose from ~$4k to ~$13.8k in under three months.

episodes.name: COVID crash
episodes.note: 12 Mar 2020 ("Black Thursday"): BTC fell ~40% in a day, to ~$3.8k at the low on 13 Mar.

episodes.name: 2020 Q4 bull run
episodes.note: Institutional buying; BTC went from ~$10.6k to over $40k.

episodes.name: May 2021 crash
episodes.note: Tesla dropped BTC payments, China moved against mining; BTC from ~$58k to ~$30k.

episodes.name: Terra/LUNA collapse
episodes.note: The UST stablecoin lost its peg and LUNA went to ~0; BTC fell below $27k.

episodes.name: Celsius / 3AC crisis
episodes.note: Celsius froze withdrawals and Three Arrows Capital failed; BTC fell to ~$17.6k.

episodes.name: FTX collapse
episodes.note: The FTX exchange halted withdrawals and went bankrupt; BTC fell to ~$15.5k.

episodes.name: USDC depeg (SVB)
episodes.note: Silicon Valley Bank failed and USDC briefly traded near $0.88; a fast drop, then a sharp rebound.

episodes.name: 2023 summer range
episodes.note: BTC stayed mostly between ~$25k and ~$31k for three months.

episodes.name: Spot ETF rally
episodes.note: US spot bitcoin ETFs began trading on 11 Jan 2024; BTC reached a new high near $73k.

episodes.name: Yen carry unwind
episodes.note: A global sell-off on 5 Aug 2024 as yen carry trades unwound; BTC briefly near $49k.
